title: Flowise SSRF protection bypass via IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (CVE-2026-69257)
summary: Flowise 3.1.2 and earlier fail to normalize IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (e.g. ::ffff:169.254.169.254) before checking the SSRF deny list in httpSecurity.ts; an ipaddr.js kind mismatch silently skips all IPv4 CIDR deny rules for such addresses. An attacker controlling DNS (AAAA record to ::ffff:<target>) bypasses all SSRF protections and reaches internal services, cloud metadata endpoints, and localhost. Fixed in 3.1.3.
